scenario: Arrange with a planar body face as Envelope always fails with '2D arrangement requires the envelope to be a face...', because K.faceInfo (src/kernel.js line 949-962) returns {center, normal, planar, type} and not n or c, so the check '!fi.planar || !fi.n' is always true (line 58 also reads fi.c, which is undefined).
fix: Use fi.normal for n and fi.center for o (lines 57-58), then add a test with a face envelope; the current scenario only covers originPlane.

scenario: The planar-normal refinement never runs, because K.faceInfo returns 'normal' and not 'n', so a decal always uses the normal stored in the selection reference rather than the face's own normal.
fix: Replace fi.n with fi.normal on lines 37 (and keep fi.planar), or drop the dead branch.

scenario: Insert 'a.json', then Update From File with 'b.json': the link file becomes b.json, but x.name stays 'a', so the toast reads 'a updated to v2' and the link name no longer matches its file.
fix: In updateXref, when file is given also set x.name = baseName(file).

scenario: Tick only the parameter 'total' (expression 'wall * 2') in Insert Derive: only 'total' is copied verbatim, so the derived design references 'wall', which it does not contain. Not verified whether the evaluator then fails the parameter.
fix: When copying a parameter, also copy the parameters its expression references (transitively), or list them as required in the dialog.

scenario: The manipulator check starts with '(await t.page.locator(...).count()) >= 0', which is always true, so the check passes even if no move, rotate or scale manipulator is shown.
fix: Drop the always-true clause and assert that the manipulator count is greater than 0 (or that screenPoint('x') is defined).
